items.headline: Indiana turns to Wilson at QB, survives Minnesota in OT
items.description: Backup quarterback Grant Wilson threw a 25-yard touchdown pass to Charlie Becker on the first play of overtime, and No. 4 Indiana came up with a stop on Minnesota's possession to close out a 23-16 victory Saturday.

items.headline: No. 4 Indiana forces overtime with a 60-yard FG then beats Minnesota 23-16
